Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 38

“Indeed, there is nothing here as purifying as knowledge. In time, one perfected in yoga finds it within oneself.”

Two claims worth holding together: knowledge is supreme, and it arrives from within, in time. Krishna adds patience to a chapter otherwise full of urgent instruction.
